messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Psychometric isomorphism
parts: Is there any available way to study psychometric isomorphism in lavaan?

You mean essentially cross-level equivalence?  lavaan currently only estimates ML-SEMs for complete, continuous data.  But generally speaking, yes you can test cross-level equivalence/isomorphism.

https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/1094428113517008

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
